description: We will caravan from Haynie's Corner (Mary's neighborhood) to Jasper to march in the Strassenfest Parade. Line up in the parking lot and be ready to leave at 9:30 a.m, on the dot! Be sure to wear your Mary Allen t-shirt. If you don't have one, order one at https://secure.actblue.com/donate/marymerc

title: Caravan from Evansville to Jasper for the Strassenfest parade — Mary Allen for Congress
